0.original: Slowfix wants you to eliminate the golems that prowl Idyllshire.

1.original: Golem sentinels left by the Sharlayans are hampering Slowfix's plans for expanding Idyllshire, and the goblin asks that you eliminate them. As a native of Sharlayan, Y'shtola may know an easy way to deal with the creatures.

2.original: Y'shtola shares with you the coded command required to unmake the golems. With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to inform each golem that you want to play a game called “Noughts and Crosses.”

3.original: You have unmade all the golems in your assigned area. Return to Slowfix with the good tidings.

4.original: You report the completion of your task to Slowfix. The goblin is pleased to hear that the golems will no longer impede the expansion effort.

25.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake golems.

48.original: Pshkohhh... So uplanders agree to help? Good! Here is what Slowfix wants uplanders to do.

49.original: Many golems prowl Idyllshire, get in the way of expansion plans. Slowfix wants uplanders to eliminate golems.

50.original: Uplanders are Sharlayan, yes? Sharlayans should know best way to deal with creatures.

51.original: Slowfix wants uplanders to eliminate golems. Uplanders are Sharlayan, yes? Sharlayans should know best way to deal with creatures.

52.original: From the goblins' perspective, such a well-appointed city is certainly an attractive proposition.

53.original: I suppose it's only to be expected that others would come and occupy Sharlayan. Nonetheless, it feels akin to having strangers take over your home in your absence.

54.original: Sentinel golems? I daresay Y'shtola will know how to deal with them.

55.original: So we are to eliminate the golems. That should be a simple enough affair.

56.original: The automata were employed as sentinels, and by design can be unmade with a coded command. At the time of the exodus, it was “Noughts and Crosses,” and I see no reason why it should not still work.

57.original: Let us divide the task between the three of us, the quicker to be finished with it.

58.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the coded command “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake a golem.

60.original: Use the coded command “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake the golems. If all goes well, we can accomplish the task without recourse to violence.

61.original: I shall see to the golems beyond this point. The area yonder, I leave in your capable hands.

63.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake a golem.

64.original: With a shudder, the golem crumbles to pieces.

66.original: Now we can resume work to expand settlement!

67.original: I'm pleased to report that my golems obediently crumbled at my command.

68.original: Of all the luck, one of my golems was not receptive to the password, and tried to pummel me bloody. Thankfully, I managed to dance clear of its fists and strike it down.
